source_consequences_used_at_cp4: Lemma 2.5 supplies a finite family (l<=L) of order-1 well-factorable upper weights at the chosen level Q.
Lemma 3.5 controls exactly the weighted residue-class bracket E_C(q) for any order-1 well-factorable weight at level Q.
The linear-sieve remainder must also contain a separate coprimality correction H_C(q); Li-Liu explicitly separates the analogous R2 term in the G8 model.
The G11/G12 text provides final Buchstab integrals but omits the alpha/beta cell compiler; CP-0004 reconstructs only this interface and not the numerical Buchstab integral audit.
